detail.longDescription: Exposed Master Key Sparks LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack A single misstep on May 27 - committing a master key to a public repository - ultimately led to a supply chain compromise on October 10, allowing a threat actor to extract a sensitive GitHub CLI OAuth token. The lapse occurred when the exposed key wasn't revoked quickly enough, leaving the door open to malicious access. https:// osintsights.com/exposed-master -key-sparks-litellm-supply-chain-attack?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social # SupplyChainAttack # Litellm # Github # Oauth # AiAgents
